Pre-orders for Capcom Arcade 2nd Stadium: Bundle 1, which features all 32 titles is now available! Pre-order now to also get the Capcom Arcade 2nd Stadium: Display Frames Set 1.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1755910/Capcom_Arcade_2nd_Stadium/

[h3]Download ""Street Fighter II  - The World Warrior -"" for Capcom Arcade Stadium, for free! This is available for a limited time until 7/21 16:59 PT.[/h3]
